mapper.select: SELECT id, total_amount, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND del_flg = false ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT o.id, o.total_amount, o.status, o.shipping_name, o.shipping_postal_code, o.shipping_address, o.shipping_phone, o.note, o.created_at, oi.product_id AS item_product_id, oi.product_name AS item_product_name, oi.unit_price AS item_unit_price, oi.quantity AS item_quantity, s3.s3_key AS item_s3_key FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id AND p.del_flg = false LEFT JOIN s3_files s3 ON s3.entity_type = 1 AND s3.entity_id = p.id AND s3.is_main_image = true AND s3.del_flg = false WHERE o.id = #{orderId} AND o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.del_flg = false ORDER BY oi.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( account_id, total_amount, shipping_name, shipping_postal_code, shipping_address, shipping_phone, note ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{totalAmount}, #{shippingName}, #{shippingPostalCode}, #{shippingAddress}, #{shippingPhone}, #{note} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity ) VALUES
( #{orderId}, #{orderItem.productId}, #{orderItem.productName}, #{orderItem.unitPrice}, #{orderItem.quantity} )
